notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161922/86a57b90df316833aa22b067de6f614c84aa4a23.png[/img]

Hello, Overseer.

     Our first hotfix for the Combat Revamp is coming through! Among the things we fixed with this round:

Invasions:
* Defense Rooms should now possess a proper attack range
* Continuous "misses" against enemies are fixed
* Invasions should end much quicker now
* Invasions power should now calculate properly taking into account your shelter level
* Pesky "null" bugs messing with your production & timers should no longer appear in your game

Equipment leveling:
* Enhancing your equipment should now return proper WAIFU stats

    We aren't resting, though! More fixes are coming through, so stay tuned for the next patch!

With hot metal on our anvils,
    --The JNT Team

notes.title: Trust System and... Item changes soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42161922/6da62aa5616f281ea9054f5f9415bb06745ba880.png[/img]

Hello, Overseer.

    We have heard your feedback in terms of our basic gameplay and combat and we are preparing some changes to address them, under the loving umbrella term of the [b]Combat Revamp[/b]!

    To get there, however, we need to first introduce a few changes to the rest of the current system so the Revamp fits in nicely, and the first change is coming soon, namely: [i][b]The Removal and Readjustment of the Trust System[/b][/i].

    Currently, introducing new (next) flirt levels for your beloved Champions met a giant wall with bold letters that spelled "[b]DESIGN LIMITATION[/b]". Not to mention, their Trust Missions became practically obsolete once they reached their max level!

    As a result, we have made the decision to trim the fat instead of leaving bits of meat dangling, and Trust Levels will be completely removed.

    To not make this throw out all of your progress with their trust, the Champion base levels will be adjusted accordingly to their Trust Levels, like so:

[b]Trust Level 1 - Champion Level 1
Trust Level 2 - Champion Level 5
Trust Level 3 - Champion Level 10
Trust Level 4 - Champion Level 15
Trust Level 5 - Champion Level 25[/b]

Flirt requirements will be replaced according to the same formula.

    This decision pulled a different problem behind it, and that is recalculating what resources you require to level them up, which we have adjusted, too.

    There are more changes incoming that are all about the Combat Revamp, but we put this one out first to ensure you will have extra time to familiarize yourself with the new levelling system.
[b]
THIS CHANGE WILL TAKE EFFECT ON TUESDAY, 23RD OF MAY AT SERVER RESET/MIDNIGHT![/b]

    Take heart, Overseer, for the Combat Revamp is coming!

With love,
    --The JNT Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.258
notes.notes:
A patch summarizing a week of work on the game was released today. Thank you for your support, suggestions and help!

1.0.257+ (week of 23-27.05)

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix several event issues, with missing tasks, not working tasks etc
[*] Fix eLDi production issues
[*] Fix radio station not producing more than 1 item when offline
[*] Fix training not working when offline
[*] Fix Now I know What It Is Achievement
[*] Fix skip timers incorrect values between backend and frontend
[*] Fix stopping room build providing 50 builders
[*] Fix crafting resources being used extra time when changing girls during enhance in crafting rooms
[*] Fix sexscenes missing control buttons sometimes
[*] Fix daily quests panel showing incorrect points during collection
[*] Fix needing to get 1 extra trust to unlock a girl ("need 0 more trust" issue)
[*] Fix several messed up timers
[*] Fix several exploits
[*] Fix legendary girls being removed from Radio Station queue
[*] Fix quantum-entangled workers
[*] Fix welcome logo not opening correctly on Steam Deck
[*] Fix several save game issues
[*] Fix incorrectly swapping girls in missions selection
[*] Fix chapter 4 level 3 hscene reward
[*] Fix requirement on Shelter level 16
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission resources are now claimed after mission load (so crashes on load will not cause losing resources)
[*] Mission - Chapter 4 Resource 1 fixed
[*] Mission - Gaia Trust Mission Fixed
[/list]
[b]Polishing[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved dragging (and pinching on touch screens) - should properly separate selecting chibi and dragging (dragging from chibi position should work nicely now)
[*] Blocked upgrading expedition room when girls are on expeditions
[/list]
[b]Quality Of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] QoL - girls sorted by primary stat when assigning girls to rooms
[*] QoL - better rooms sorting in Shelter Overview and several fixes there
[*] QoL - adds total Disassenbly Queue time
[*] QoL - shows which Shelter Level is needed to level up Champions
[*] QoL - Trust and Crafting items show their rarity on inventory cards (also makes it clearer what Gacha rewards are given)
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix several typos
[*] Optimization - improved memory usage
[/list]
